section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Radio, Stereo Tape Player and Antenna
title: 2. FAINT RECEPTION

content.description: Troubleshooting flowchart for faint reception starting with checking if both reception and static are faint with antenna fully lengthened

steps.decision: Are both reception and static faint with antenna fully lengthened?

steps.ok: Inspect antenna, cable and booster and repair as necessary.

content.description: Illustration showing a hand adjusting the AM antenna trimmer on a car radio/stereo unit. The radio has multiple control knobs and displays, with an arrow pointing to the trimmer adjustment location.

items: With the volume and tone at maximum, turn the dial to around 1,400 kHz where there is no reception.
Adjust the trimmer to where static is loudest.
